name: LO-Angle!!
source:
Tooru has three cute and lively younger sisters: Eri, Miku and Yako. He couldn’t help but notice their bodies gradually turning into that of a woman and tried his best to resist his urges. With his cousins Momoka and Makoto also showing up, will he be able to hold out in this "semi-little girl" heaven?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Toru有三个可爱活泼的妹妹：Eri、Miku和Yako。他情不自禁地看着他们的身体渐渐变成了女人，努力克制着自己的冲动。堂弟桃华和真琴也现身，他能否在这个“准小女”天堂里站稳脚跟呢？

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
